decisions.decision: Claude takes the build. (1) Check tantra-backend-v2 (development branch, read only) for how campaign step templates fill in contact customFields, e.g. {{customFields.first_line}}. Contacts already accept scalar customFields (integrations-tantra-api.md lines 115 and 171). If templates can't fill them in, put the first line into the step body per contact through the import and record the gap. (2) Write workshop-plan/scripts/first_lines.py: lead CSV in, CSV with first_line out, using Claude, matching the proven playbook's style, no client name, no dashes. Record the path in the log. (3) Use the existing Tantra key in ~/.config/tantra to make a test omni-channel campaign, import 3 sample leads with first_line, and send only to [email] (sender name "Adi test"). Screenshot the received email. (4) Get the real batch and the control batch ready (same list split in two, with a reply-rate tracking sheet) and hand the send to T-058's outreach run. Then set status to review.
decisions.why: Steps 1 to 3 are buildable on our own systems (google-and-reminder-model, owner-decisions-2026-10-06 test identity). Tantra contacts support customFields (API doc s5). Sending to real prospects is outside-person messaging, so it goes with T-058's launch.
